provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: antecedent witness is the Mame, Tours 1922 (editio quarta iuxta typicam Vaticanam); 98% of the 1962 body's tokens align in order after canon folding; the witness text layer damages 'constantiz' where the 1962 prints 'constantiae'; the Mame prints j where the 1962 prints i (Iesum/Jesum, eius/ejus) and its recogniser renders the ae ligature as 'z' or 'e'; both are orthographic; pointing: the antecedent's reading is recorded verbatim above so its commas and colons can be compared, but its punctuation is NOT safely collatable - the recogniser turns commas into full stops, semicolons and question marks - so no punctuation difference here should be read as a difference between the printings; the 1962 prints the conclusion as 'Per Dominum.'; conclusion length was excluded from the alignment and is recorded here as printed, per the settled rule. Corroboration: Pustet 1862 text-layer lines 76225-76238 (70% coverage); Benziger 1962 conformed printing at line 95630 (84%; comparison only, never a publication basis).

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui hodierna die beatum Dionysium, Martyrem tuum atque Pontificem,
virtute constantiae in passione roborasti, quique illi, ad praedicandum
gentibus gloriam tuam, Rusticum et Eleutherium sociare dignatus es: tribue
nobis, quaesumus; eorum imitatione, pro amore tuo prospera mundi despicere,
et nulla ejus adversa formidare. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Oblata tibi, Domine, munera populi tui, pro tuorum honore Sanctorum, suscipe
propitius, quaesumus: et eorum nos intercessione sanctifica. Per Dominum
nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Sumptis, Domine, sacramentis, quaesumus: ut, intercedentibus beatis
Martyribus tuis Dionysio, Rustico et Eleutherio, ad redemptionis aeternae
proficiamus augmentum. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui
tecum vivit et regnat.
